newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Expressway seen in HK$1.30-1.43 bln float.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Expressway seen in HK$1.30-1.43 bln float.

text.p: Shenzhen Expressway Co Ltd is expected to issue 650 million H-shares at HK$2.00 to HK$2.20 per share, raising HK$1.30 billion to HK$1.43 billion to fund a toll road project and to cut debt, market sources said on Monday.
The issue price is expected to represent a discount of about 20 to 30 percent to Shenzhen Expressway's net asset value per share, sources said.

"About 10 percent of the issue is for flotation in Hong Kong, 35 percent for placing in the U.S. market and the remainder for an international placement," said one analyst after attending a company presentation on Monday.
The public offering in Hong Kong is expected to run from March 4-7 and dealing in the company shares is scheduled to begin on March 13, they added.
The issue price will be fixed on March 7, sources said.
"About HK$792 million (of the proceeds) will be used to fund construction of a toll road project -- Jihe Expressway West in Shenzhen -- and HK$383 million for reducing debt," one analyst said.
"The company gave an initial earnings forecast of about 206 million yuan for the year ending in December 1997," she added.
Merrill Lynch is expected to be the global coordinator of the issue, sources said.
Shenzhen Expressway is majority owned by Chinese state enterprise Shenzhen Freeway Co.
According to an SBC Warburg research report, Shenzhen Expressway has four road projects of which three are already in operation and collecting tolls.
The report said the construction of the fourth project -- Jihe Expressway East -- is expected to be completed by the end of 1997, while Jihe Expressway West is the company's next major project.
